description: Information GES is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. SNCF Voyageurs publie sa méthodologie de calcul de quantité de gaz à effet de serre (GES) émise à l'occasion d'une prestation de transport, conformément à l'article L1431.3 du Code des Transports. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Informations institutionnelles et financières. Its keywords are RSE, GES, empreinte carbone, CO2. The portal shows 2025-10-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/cgu/A1#A1). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
